prompt:
Use case: game sprite atlas. Create a transparent PNG atlas of THREE separate front-facing vertical PAINTED WOOD THEATER PROP SIGNBOARDS, arranged in one evenly spaced horizontal row. Reference image is the game's existing settings wooden board: match its warm honey-colored carved thick wooden rim, slightly irregular handmade outline, subtle wood grain, matte gouache storybook stage prop rendering and warm painted highlights. These are tangible stage scenery painted on plywood, not fabric banners, not parchment, not modern glass panels.
Canvas landscape 1536x1024. Strict layout: divide into three equal 512x1024 cells. Each board fits within its cell x+24 through x+488, y=70 through y=954; same exact silhouette and size for all three. Leave true transparent margins and gaps; boards never touch. No cast shadow outside silhouette. No hanging ropes or lettering; ropes and native text will be added in game.
Each board has a chunky golden-brown carved wooden edge, small bevel showing thickness, warm pale cream painted wood interior with subtle visible timber grain. Different muted hand-painted accents around the interior: left indigo and antique gold; center sage teal and cream; right burgundy and old gold. Keep most of the interior light enough for dark brown UI typography.
Reserve interior y=130..275 COMPLETELY BLANK for native title. Illustrated central area y=305..570 only: LEFT board a fan of three beautiful painted cards, blue, antique gold and muted violet, with simple fine celestial star designs on their backs. CENTER board three hand-painted glass potion-bottle silhouettes on the wood, green with a simple white plus, blue with a simple shield, plum with a gold star. RIGHT board a small crest medal, faceted gold-and-teal gem, and a little closed treasure chest, all painted directly onto the pale timber, not round app icons. Illustrations should have hand-painted brushwork and no enclosing black rectangle, no realistic glossy glass. Retain warm coherent wood texture under everything.
Reserve interior y=610..860 COMPLETELY BLANK for two-line description and small native action hint. A tiny understated decorative gold star and thin ornamental line near y=885 allowed. All ornament inside board. The object imagery is on the upper-middle only. All three are upright, orthographic, no perspective tilt. No Chinese or English text, no numbers, no labels, no invented alphabet anywhere. Actual alpha background required.
